name: CHP Explorer Post (East Sacramento)
what_you_do: Join the CHP Explorer post at the East Sacramento office. Explorers help officers in the office and the field: DUI checkpoints, ride-alongs, community service and Explorer competitions. You get fitness, medical and office training.
who_can_apply: Ages 15 to 20 on the CHP Explorer eligibility page (the East Sacramento office page says 15 to 21). You need at least a 2.0 GPA, no drug or alcohol use and no felony convictions.
how_to_apply: Email the East Sacramento Explorer advisor, Sergeant John Daubner (JDaubner@chp.ca.gov), or call the office at (916) 464-1450 to get an application. After you apply you need a background check and a medical exam by a doctor.
notes: Read in a browser on 2026-10-19. The old Explorer post page on chp.ca.gov now loads blank, so the card links to the East Sacramento Area office page, which has an Explorer section and the advisor's email. The office is at 11336 Trade Center Drive, Rancho Cordova. The eligibility rules come from CHP's careers site (linked from chp.ca.gov). Ages differ: the eligibility page says 15 to 20 and the office page says 15 to 21, so ask the advisor. Meeting times are not posted. See also California Highway Patrol Explorer Program for the statewide competition.
